278.title: The Shawshank Redemption
278.overview: Imprisoned in the 1940s for the double murder of his wife and her lover, upstanding banker Andy Dufresne begins a new life at the Shawshank prison, where he puts his accounting skills to work for an amoral warden. During his long stretch in prison, Dufresne comes to be admired by the other inmates -- including an older prisoner named Red -- for his integrity and unquenchable sense of hope.

406.title: La Haine
406.overview: After a chaotic night of rioting in a marginal suburb of Paris, three young friends, Vinz, Hubert and Saïd, wander around unoccupied waiting for news about the state of health of a mutual friend who has been seriously injured when confronting the police.

1366.title: Rocky
1366.overview: Rocky Balboa is a Philadelphia club fighter who seems to be going nowhere. But when a stroke of fate puts him in the ring with a world heavyweight champion, Rocky knows that it's his one shot at the big time — a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to go the distance and come out a winner!

5590.title: Donkey Skin
5590.overview: A fairy godmother helps a princess disguise herself so she won't have to marry her father.
5590.trailerName: Peau d'âne de Jacques Demy bande annonce

23446.title: One Piece: Clockwork Island Adventure
23446.overview: Relaxing on a cozy beach, the Straw Hat Pirates are taking a rest from their quest. Right until Luffy noticed the Going Merry has been hijacked and sailed off from the beach. This leads them to search the ship and find the thief who took it from them. They ran into a duo named the Theif Brothers, who informed them that their ship was stolen by a group of pirates called the Trump Kyoudai. When they encountered the Trump Pirates, Nami ended up getting kidnapped as well as Luffy's hat. They tracked down the pirates to their base on Clockwork Island. Now Luffy, Zoro, Sanji, Usopp, and the Theif Brothers must reclaim the Going Merry, Save Nami, and get back Shank's straw hat.
23446.original_title: ワンピース ねじまき島の冒険

167126.title: First Graders
167126.overview: A documentary film about a boys school in Iran. The film shows numerous, funny and moving interviews of many different young pupils of this school summoned by their superintendent for questions of discipline. The man is not severe, but clever and fair. He teaches loyalty, fellowship and righteousness to these boys. Besides these interviews, we see scenes of this school’s quotidian life.

854934.title: Mabel
854934.overview: Mabel centers on Callie, whose only friends are the plants and trees that surround her home. When her dad’s job moves the family to a sterile subdivision, she is utterly isolated—except for her best friend, a potted plant named Mabel. To Callie, Mabel is a peer, a fellow being, maybe overlooked or unseen, but still very much alive.

893462.title: O-DE-KA-KE Diary Part 2 - The Home of Grass
893462.original_title: 続・おでかけ日記～第2章～草の家

959894.title: Pallichattambi
959894.overview: Small-town schemer Chattambi survives by staying ahead of his neighbors through risky plans. When his plans backfire, he has to depend on extricating himself from the mess he created.

974230.title: Guria
974230.overview: GURIA (its a region in western Georgia) is an astute dramedy about everyday life in a village in western Georgia. This poignant, yet humorous slice of life, brims with charming, loveable characters – fighting against all odds to live a proud and joyful life. Guria champions ingenuity, kindness, and the eternal search for love despite a raging civil war. Though set after the collapse of the Soviet Union, it is a timely reminder of how shared humanity and compassion are the truest measure of our capacity.

977942.title: The Uprising
977942.overview: As war and plague devastate 14th-century England, a humble peasant ignites a rebellion, uniting an army of commoners to defy the King’s might in a desperate fight for justice and survival.

1115030.title: Animal Friends
1115030.overview: Two fugitive animals embark on an adventure across America to find the ranch that was once their home, healing their friendship while pursued by an equally "odd-couple" DEA agent and Fish and Wildlife ranger with something to prove.

1145110.title: King
1145110.overview: Mentor and disciple embark on a perilous journey, pushing their survival skills to the limit against overwhelming odds and unforgiving environments.

1171094.title: Ek Din
1171094.overview: Dino is in love with his colleague Meera but lacks the courage to express his feelings. He finally gets his chance during the company trip. He makes a wish to be with Meera for just one day, and his wish comes true.

1189974.title: Arch Nemesis
1189974.overview: After years of estrangement, Thomas and Andrew Kent must relive their past to reconcile once and for all.

1212310.title: Winter of the Crow
1212310.overview: Warsaw, December 13, 1981. Martial law shuts down the country. Overnight, a country turns into a prison. Taxis have been replaced by tanks. Citizens are treated like criminals. And visiting British Professor Joan Andrews finds herself trapped. After witnessing the murder of a young student by the secret police (the "Crows"), Joan herself becomes the target.
1212310.trailerName: Winter of the Crow | Official Trailer | In Theaters October 9

1215638.title: Checkered Ninja 3
1215638.overview: In this 3rd installment Alex’s interest for Ninja missions is starting to vanish. He’ll rather spend his time with his friends and Checkered Ninja feels he is overlooked and is eager to engage in a new mission. The result of this is that Alex, by accident, ends up having a conflict with Marco, the bad boy boyfriend of Jessica, entangling him in a conflict he hasn’t asked for and he is pressured by Checkered Ninja to defend himself.

1219542.title: Die drei ??? – Toteninsel
1219542.overview: The three investigators want to go on a road trip during their vacation, but just as they are about to set off, the phone rings and an unknown caller hands the trio of detectives their latest case: the archaeologists belonging to the secret society Sphinx are carrying out illegal excavations and selling the stolen art treasures. Their next target is the supposedly cursed island of Makatao.

1235286.title: Nomad Shadow
1235286.overview: A young Sahrawi woman faces deportation to Western Sahara, struggling to readjust to her homeland and confront family tensions sparked by her earlier departure.

1239958.title: Our Loves
1239958.overview: Based on true events. The story of 7 characters whose lives will unknowingly entangle. Each character is trapped in a failed relationship due to both tragic and comedic events, which leads them all to a shared belief: October 6th, the day the love died, is their worst day ever. The following day, during Hamas' sudden attack on Israel, they'll desperately have to try to survive while figuring out the true meaning of their lives and what must be changed.

1241046.title: A Prayer for the Dying
1241046.overview: In 1870 Friendship, Wisconsin, a small town of Scandinavian settlers still suffering the repercussions of the recent Civil War. When faced with a new and even deadlier threat, one man is forced to make a harrowing choice: save his young family or defend the community that gave him a second chance at life and meaning.

1257942.title: It's My Time
1257942.overview: At the age of seventy, a fiercely non-conformist grandmother partners with a lethargic, underachieving young prodigy to navigate the highly competitive and eccentric subculture of speedcubing, defying familial skepticism and generational expectations.

1274134.title: I Live Here Now
1274134.overview: A woman finds herself trapped in a remote hotel where the violent echoes of her past come alive, blurring the lines between her darkest nightmares and the waking world.

1282774.title: Magic Hour
1282774.overview: Erin and Charlie escape to the desert to navigate an unexpected and challenging new phase of their relationship.

1301270.title: Skate to Hell
1301270.overview: A group of teenagers steal a supernatural skateboard owned by Satan's son. Now the devil wants it back.
1301270.trailerName: Skate to Hell - Official Teaser Trailer

ads.name: Amazon Prime Video Free with Ads

1308694.title: Veranda
1308694.overview: After the sudden death of her husband, Ha-yeon is left in shock and quietly tries to return to everyday life. But an unexpected threatening phone call makes her feel that she is being watched. In a state of anxiety and isolation, Ha-yeon gradually finds comfort in Hyun-woo, the neighbor who lives upstairs. As details surrounding her husband's death begin to surface, she is drawn into an increasingly complex web of secrets and suspicion.

1318998.title: House of Ka
1318998.overview: After her father contracts a supernatural illness, a young aristocrat named Margaret Trelawny and a gentleman lawyer unravel a deadly mystery to save her father's life.

1362262.title: CAMP
1362262.overview: Emily is the cause of two tragedies early in her life; her dad suggests she go to a Camp for troubled youth to ease her guilt. When Emily arrives, she is taken in by the other counsellors; they accept her as she is and wrap her in a veil of peace & forgiveness. Emily stands at the forefront of a new kind of life, but there’s a voice out there in the woods she can’t ignore, telling Emily to go home.

1363286.title: Demonte Colony 3
1363286.overview: Srini and Debbie set out to find a missing librarian, but their search soon leads them into a dark and mysterious world. As they uncover hidden secrets, they find themselves unraveling a sinister mystery far more dangerous than they imagined

1376470.title: Look At The Sky, Trust The Mountains
1376470.overview: A tense drama set after the Taliban takeover, following a French agent escorting an Afghan girl across a dangerous country as they form a life-changing bond.

1378262.title: The Hole, 309 Days to the Bloodiest Tragedy
1378262.overview: When a spate of gruesome killings rocks the countryside in East Jakarta, army officer Soegeng is tasked with clearing up rumours about the military’s involvement. Soegeng’s investigation, however, confronts him with the foundations of corruption – a truth too close for comfort.
1378262.original_title: Lobang Buaya, 309 Hari Sebelum Tragedi Berdarah

1381078.title: Love of Your Life
1381078.overview: After a chance encounter sparks a sweeping romance, Maya's future is suddenly upended, sending her on an unexpected journey to love and live again.

1383190.title: Black Sheeps
1383190.overview: A young scientist who is convinced that a dangerous new pathogen threatens the population and tracks it back to her hometown – which is located in the shadow of the remote sheep station where the macabre events of the original Black Sheep unfolded.

1393942.title: Jitters
1393942.overview: Detective Collymore, a single divorced father, stumbles upon a mysterious case involving the death of Tiffany, initially deemed natural. Digging deeper, he discovers the horrors of Jitters.

1398486.title: Maigret and the Dead Lover
1398486.overview: Commissioner Maigret rushes to the Quai d’Orsay with Lieutenant Janvier. There, they find Mademoiselle Larrieu in a state of shock. That very morning, she discovered the bullet-riddled body of Mr. Berthier-Lagès, a renowned former ambassador whom she had served as a housekeeper for 46 years. While searching the victim's apartment, Maigret and Janvier uncover hundreds of letters. The diplomat had maintained a fifty-year-long love correspondence with a certain Princess of Vuynes, whose husband - by a strange coincidence - had died just a few days earlier. As he confronts the various members of the two families and the suspicious silence of Mademoiselle Larrieu, Maigret finds himself faced with surprise after surprise, watching his certainties crumble - until the solution to the mystery finally hits him in the face at the very last moment...
1398486.trailerName: MAIGRET AND THE DEAD LOVER - Official HD Trailer - Only In Cinemas

1400214.title: Maspalomas
1400214.overview: After breaking up with his partner, 76 year-old Vicente leads life the way he likes it in Maspalomas: he spends his days lying in the sun, partying, and looking for pleasure. An unexpected accident obliges him to return to San Sebastián and to the daughter he abandoned years ago. Vicente will have to live in a retirement home where he finds himself driven back into the closet and to conceal a part of himself that he thought was long resolved. In this new environment, Vicente must ask himself if he has enough time left to make his peace with others… and with himself.

1418582.title: Here the Whole Time
1418582.overview: An insecure teenager's vacation plans are ruined by an unexpected visitor: his neighbor and school crush who will spend two weeks sleeping at his house. The days that promised peace, tranquility and epic series marathons end up bringing a whirlwind of feelings and unresolved issues.

1434326.title: Street Smart
1434326.overview: A look into the lives of a lively group of unhoused young adults in the iconic beach town, who come together with humor and a bit of Robin Hood-style larceny, forging unbreakable bonds and redefining what it means to be a family.

1435606.title: Assi
1435606.overview: When Parima, a school teacher in Delhi, is gang-raped on her way home late at night after an office party, Raavi, a prosecution lawyer, fights tooth and nail to help her get justice. But when eighty sexual assault cases are reported in India every single day, regardless of age group, ethnicity, time, or place,  and only four go to trial, what does justice really mean?

1465814.title: This Island
1465814.overview: Bebo, a teenager from a coastal Puerto Rican town, lives with his brother in a public housing complex. They fish for a living, but growing desperation drives them to illegal dealings that promise easy money. When a job goes wrong and blood is spilled, Bebo flees with Lola, a wealthy girl seeking to escape her troubled reality. As they navigate the labyrinthine mountains, they encounter remnants of a fading way of life, contrasting with the violence that follows them. As hitmen close in, Bebo must confront his choices and decide if redemption is possible, or if the sea will be their final escape. A portrait of the Puerto Rican experience that dives into the complexities of identity, resilience, and colonial legacy, the film had its world premiere at the Tribeca Film Festival, where it was honored with Best Cinematography, Best New Director, and the Jury Award. It was also nominated for the prestigious Spirit Awards, solidifying its place as one of the most celebrated Puerto Rican films.

1473878.title: Speed Demon
1473878.overview: Aboard a high-speed train, a Nun who lost her faith must perform her first Exorcism on a possessed passenger hellbent on crashing the runaway train.

1477654.title: The Crystal Planet
1477654.overview: 11-year-old Rea has recently moved to a distant planet in an outer-space colony where she discovers a mysterious animal cub while her father works in a factory that builds robotic creatures. With the help of her new friend Andy, she must protect the real cub from the factory’s ruthless owner, who intends to turn it into a robotic prototype.
1477654.trailerName: TAJOMSTVO KRIŠTÁĽOVEJ PLANÉTY - OFICIÁLNY TRAILER - V KINÁCH OD 13. AUGUSTA

1480790.title: The Sin Trade
1480790.overview: In the late 1990s, detective Chi Feng navigates a violent turf war between rival trafficking syndicates to dismantle both criminal groups and rescue a group of abducted women.

1487062.title: Byeeee
1487062.overview: After getting busted for defrauding her investors, tech girlboss entrepreneur Andy is heading to her family’s abandoned lakeside cottage for one last weekend before she kills herself.

1489430.title: The Fatigued
1489430.overview: Liuba and Andrii, two war veterans bearing both physical wounds and the invisible scars of PTSD, find solace in each other as they navigate the long road to recovery. Their bond offers a fragile hope for healing, but as they confront the lasting impact of trauma and the challenge of rebuilding their lives, their connection is tested in a quiet, deeply human struggle for love, strength, and renewal.

1493590.title: Attack of the Killer Tomatoes: Organic Intelligence
1493590.overview: "Jurassic Park" meets "Dr. Strangelove". It's a reprise and fifth feature spin of the 1978 Cult Classic "Attack of the Killer Tomatoes," the franchise that went from 80s midnight screenings to help launch the Fox Children's TV Network.
1493590.trailerName: Introducing My Tomato™ – Organic Intelligence OS (Beta Preview)
1493590.original_title: Attack of the Killer Tomatoes: Organic Intelligence

1495638.title: The Caretaker
1495638.overview: A recently bereaved man takes up a caretaker position at an elite academy and soon uncovers dark secrets.
1495638.trailerName: New Disturbing Gothic Horror Movie: THE CARETAKER Trailer (FrightFest Official Selection)

1504150.title: How to Save the Immortal. The Mystery of Living Water
1504150.overview: Three hundred years of Koshchey's search for a chosen one have finally been crowned with success, and preparations for the wedding with Varvara are in full swing. However, his cherished dream will not come true so easily, and now Koshchey, along with the Good fellow Elisha and Kolobok, embarks on a dangerous journey to save his beloved.

1506710.title: God Laughs
1506710.overview: In the heart of the 17th century, Friar Leopoldo da Casamacchia recounts the Gospel with a joy and freedom never seen before. While the Church speaks in Latin, he speaks to the people of a God who is close to them, capable of bringing comfort, hope, and even of laughing alongside them. His voice spreads from village to village, winning over thousands of people and emptying the churches. The echo of his message reaches as far as Rome, where the Pope entrusts the case to Cardinal Maculani, the most influential inquisitor of the time. What begins as a trial turns into an unexpected confrontation, capable of shaking seemingly unshakable convictions. While Leopoldo’s fate seems sealed, doubt begins to change even those who judge him. Because you can silence a voice, but not what that voice has left behind in others.

1517206.title: Bouchra
1517206.overview: Wrestling with writer’s block for her first film, Bouchra, a queer Moroccan jackal living in NYC, starts having difficult yet overdue phone calls with her mother in Casablanca that begin influencing the project. Balancing the precarity of working as an artist, the rift in her cultural identity and an array of romantic interests, Bouchra’s emotional reckoning becomes her path to expression.

1529622.title: Semillas
1529622.overview: In Eliana Niño’s poignant and charming feature debut, Shaira, a girl from the eastern plains of Colombia, dreams of participating in a coleo festival (an event similar to a rodeo). But after a recent drought severely damaged the crops, Shaira’s grandfather sells her horse without telling her. One day, he tells Shaira that the reason why some clouds take the shape of animals is that the sky traps them and won’t return them until it rains again. Shaira embarks on a journey to go in search of a special seed that will make the heavens rain again to bring her horse back.

1532438.title: Dragon Fury 3
1532438.overview: Deep within a high-security government bunker, an ancient nightmare has broken loose. This time, there’s nowhere to run. A daring break-in at a classified research facility quickly turns into a bloodbath when a group of intruders discovers they aren't alone. Instead of the secrets they came for, they find themselves hunted by genetically engineered, apex predators: lethal dragons with a taste for human prey. Trapped between a tactical lockdown and the jaws of prehistoric monsters, the group must fight through dark corridors and deadly traps. It’s a race against time to escape before the facility is purged - or the dragons finish their feast.

1542102.title: The Long Haul
1542102.overview: Long-haul trucking has been CJ's entire life. When she receives a letter from the parole board, everything she has been running from finally catches up to her; forcing her to deal with her past, present, and future all at once.

1552406.title: Guard
1552406.overview: A young lifeguard finds herself isolated from her peers as she struggles with the weight of mortality.

1555734.title: A Mighty Adventure
1555734.overview: Three little insects are transported to a concrete city. A series of extraordinary micro-adventures forces them to explore themselves and helps to build their self-esteem, so they can finally get back home. They become much stronger and happier, are able to choose their own future.

1571030.title: Herbstfeuer
1571030.overview: A passionate hotel manager is obsessed with a clairvoyant's claim that he is to blame for the unexplained fire at his legendary grand hotel. To free himself from this burden, he teams up with an astute detective inspector to expose a former employee as the arsonist. This unexpectedly puts him at the centre of the investigation – and he must face the truth.

1580374.title: Cry Out
1580374.overview: Akiko, a girl living a hard life after her father passes away and her mother's new boyfriend turns abusive, starts receiving encouraging letters from her 30-year-old-future self. Akiko also starts to get bullied in school, and her teacher Shinomiya tries to help her, but ends up losing her job. Akiko also unearths a story written to her by her father, telling her how he originally met her mother, who was the abused daughter of a politician.
1580374.trailerName: Trailer for the film "Mirai" [Released in May 2026]

1582038.title: Las Hijas
1582038.overview: A twenty-year-old girl wakes up in a house in the woods after a night of partying. Three young women greet her as the daughters of her kidnapper. They too were kidnapped, and their isolation led them to embrace this community as idyllic.

1592790.title: Just Look Up
1592790.overview: A defiant young visionary, part stand-up comic, part young Bob Dylan, part brilliant mind, leads a disruptive climate movement reinventing protest, channeling civil disobedience, and demanding a livable future.

1601174.title: Chelot
1601174.overview: The story follows Haqqim, a special operations police officer, who is forced to become an informant for a crime syndicate to overcome financial pressure and save his family. This desperate act puts himself and his loved ones in danger.

1608982.title: From the Ashes: The Pit
1608982.overview: Trapped in an underground pit during a storm, three students from an all-girls school must confront their personal conflicts as they fight to survive.

1610198.title: cockroach
1610198.overview: A working student bustles through scorching Manila, pushed to a cycle of exhaustion as the disparities of a distant world of capitalist excess kindle a common tenderness.

1613398.title: Running Man Việt Nam Mùa 3: Con Rối Tự Do
1613398.overview: To survive in this world, we are forced to run and bind ourselves to the values of wealth, talent, desire, and fame. Like invisible puppet masters, they turn each of us into marionettes on a glittering stage of vanity. Yet even when our hands are tied by society’s rules, we still have the right to choose how we dance to our own rhythm. If we are destined to be puppets, then let us be free ones.
1613398.trailerName: [OFFICIAL TRAILER] RUNNING MAN VIỆT NAM MÙA 3: CON RỐI TỰ DO | KC: 24.01.2026 TẠI CGV TOÀN QUỐC

1634902.title: The Train
1634902.overview: On the final journey of the legendary Majestic Imperator Train de Luxe, Europe’s elite boards for a farewell voyage. Owner Leo Goldberg stages a glamorous on-board show and private auction as the train travels from Vienna to Prague via Budapest, selling the Majestic to the highest bidder. But the train is more than a luxury relic: it is a controlled, mobile platform with secure compartments, limited exits, and near-total anonymity. That makes it irresistible to intelligence agencies. A Russian agent under deep cover, MI6 operatives posing as newlyweds, Chinese agents secretly wiring the train for surveillance, and a former special forces officer traveling with his daughter all converge on board. Behind champagne and polite conversation, a covert war unfolds. As the train speeds through the night, the stakes rise, trust erodes, and escape routes disappear.

1635158.title: Imaginal Disk
1635158.overview: This film accompanying concept album 'Imaginal Disk' takes you on the journey of True on the path to becoming the "purest you". What soon unfolds is a cinematic, hypnotically beautiful quest to rediscover the essence of being a human.

1638038.title: Maleepnedos
1638038.overview: An epic journey of uncanny proportion in which two friends must adapt and survive the peculiarities of this strange new world.

1639382.title: To Dance is to Resist
1639382.overview: Queer couple Jay and Vol'demar find strength and community in Kyiv's underground rave scene, where dance becomes both survival and resistance in the face of war.
1639382.trailerName: TO DANCE IS TO RESIST | Official Trailer (2025) | 4K | Documentary Film

1641750.title: Purgatory
1641750.overview: In the early 1980s, 13-year-old Beatrice Gravel's comfortable world—family, school, and church—fractures when her mother moves out to 'self actualize', leaving Beatrice and her younger sister Chloe with their devastated father. As Beatrice doubles down on a plan to 'fix' her family, she barrels through bullies, friendship blowups, a make-out party, and a kleptomaniac babysitter—forcing her to decide who she wants to be when she can’t get what she wants.

1643094.title: Doggies 2
1643094.overview: A sequel to the magnetic story about love for people and dogs, but now the focus is on the main character, who is a boy. There are even more animals, and not just dogs, and this time it's women that are turning into them!
1643094.original_title: Песики. Історія його кохання або повний зоопарк

1644758.title: Angel (iii)
1644758.overview: A spectral first-person journey through Los Angeles layers the city across itself as our guide disassociates, giving way to an abstracted daytime ghost story following a woman's splitting of self and perception. ANGEL PROJECT continues.

1650454.title: Crack of dawn
1650454.overview: After being laid off, Ji-won, an outsourced sanitation worker in a provincial town, seeks reinstatement but is met with indifference. When he uncovers a secret about his coworker Jun-seo, he confronts the supervisor who pushed him out, demanding an apology. That night, an accident forces him to choose between truth and survival.

1654550.title: Dagnabbit!
1654550.overview: A homeowner. A crawlspace. An unwanted guest.
1654550.trailerName: DAGNABBIT! // Official Horror-Comedy Short Film Trailer

1654870.title: Goodbye My Car
1654870.overview: A veteran movie star faces a career crisis after a misinterpreted remark sparks public backlash and scrutiny over his driving and reputation.
1654870.trailerName: 『免許返納!?』主題歌予告【6月19日(金)公開】

1654998.title: R.L. Stine's Pumpkinhead 2
1654998.overview: Sam and Becka race to stop a new Pumpkinhead curse from claiming the entire town of Redhaven.

1655446.title: Takkuuk
1655446.overview: Takkuuk is an Inuktitut word meaning to be attentive or to look closely. It is often used to describe the environmental and cultural changes in the Arctic. In the film of the same name, we meet musicians and researchers from the Arctic who explore life, communities, and the challenges they face.  The film is a collaboration between Belfast duo BICEP, visual artist Zak Norman, and filmmaker Charlie Miller. They weave documentary realism, music video aesthetics, and artistic abstraction together with the perspectives of indigenous peoples on the impact of colonialism and industrialization.  The narrative is punctuated by musical vignettes from Inuit and Sami artists (including Greenlandic rapper Tarrak and Sami singer Katarina Barruk), which together form the backbone of BICEP’s score. Meanwhile, specially built cameras capture the Arctic landscapes in surreal, alien colors that reflect a rapidly changing world.

1657110.title: Cinta Lama Babak Kedua #CLBK
1657110.overview: Ambar and Raka have planned their wedding and dreamed of a happy future together, just like any other couple. But their plans are put to the test when Akung Abi and Nin Sita — their grandfather and grandmother — turn out to be former lovers who parted ways 56 years ago. Since their youth, the relationship between Abi and Sita has been shaped by a past filled with stories that were never truly resolved. Without realizing it, that unfinished history begins to affect Ambar and Raka’s relationship in the present. The deeper they uncover their grandparents’ past, the more they feel that something has remained unsettled for the last 56 years.
1657110.trailerName: Cinta Lama Babak Kedua - Official Trailer

1658070.title: Filthy
1658070.overview: When an actress goes looking for the man who assaulted her, she turns her trauma into art and asks the question nobody wanted her to: why didn't you do anything?
1658070.original_title: Sucia. Per què no vas fer res?

1661910.title: Penguin
1661910.overview: Returning from Antarctica, a man brings his partner a rare gift. The gift causes a shift in their relationship, which is difficult to cope with. Has the man changed, or is it the woman who suddenly sees him differently?

1665750.title: Konspirasi
1665750.overview: An elite team is deployed to seize a hidden server containing a list of corrupt politicians and offshore financial transactions. Led by Adli and his team, the covert mission turns into a trap when some of the data leaks to the media and the dark web, triggering a national political crisis. As public trust begins to erode and suspicions arise about internal traitors, the team uncovers clues pointing to a cyber expert and a renowned hacker. What starts as a secret operation soon develops into a dangerous conspiracy involving a power struggle in politics, large-scale cyberattacks, and foreign interference aiming to destabilise the country.
1665750.trailerName: Konspirasi | Official Trailer | Akan Datang Di Pawagam GSC mulai 21 Mei 2026

1671446.title: Almost Cupid
1671446.overview: To get his wings, a newly hired cupid must choose between doing the job and honouring free will after being assigned to save a toxic relationship that shouldn't exist.

1678230.title: Hand Drawn
1678230.overview: Barney, a concept artist forced to work long hours, can’t keep his work life balance in check. All this changes, when his boss offers him a cybernetic hand that could triple his output. This makes life easier, but over time his wife Jasmine realises that the arm is draining him of his humanity by removing him of his own creative process.

1680854.title: Pre-Parenting
1680854.overview: Shu-Han uses augmented reality glasses to get a head start on parenthood. When a car crash claims her unborn daughter and embeds a lens fragment in her brain, she begins to see the child everywhere.

1684246.title: Untold UK: Vinnie Jones
1684246.overview: This is the story of Vinnie Jones's rise, fall, and comeback against odds – and red cards – from one of football's most notorious hard men to FA cup winner.

1684310.title: Gregor
1684310.overview: The discovery of a human skull fragment plunges Gregor into a hallucinatory thriller blending violence, power, and extreme fantasies...

1686422.title: OUT
1686422.overview: After learning an online friend is considering suicide, Makoto, a young non-binary hikikomori, must try to save her while remaining trapped at home due to fear of the outside world.

1687830.title: Jordi i Nil, la conversa infinita

1688918.title: Maxita

We follow him on a journey to Brumadinho, where he encounters the aftermath of the Brumadinho dam disaster. Between the earthly and the spiritual realms, his path intersects with the maxita watimapë—the “earth eaters” — and leads him to reunite with his longtime ally Ailton Krenak.

1699862.title: Dreams of Violets

Through the eyes of five strangers, it brings protest footage to life with raw immediacy. At dawn, as Iranian forces execute wounded protesters, a violent soldier discovers the five hiding in a dead-end  alley. Above them, Amir, a child in a wheelchair, watches from a window and decides to act.

Their shared alienation fuels both a fierce global movement and an intimate love story. But as their actions spread across continents and inspire thousands, they find themselves unable to escape the heavy costs of living on the front lines of revolution.

1721430.title: Expo Inferno

1721622.title: A Shadow in the Corner of the Room
1721622.overview: Down-on-her-luck nurse, Avery, dismisses a care home resident's warnings of a shadowy presence as dementia...until it begins to turn its attention to her.

1722006.title: Bangungot

1722710.title: While the Rain Falls
1722710.overview: When a rainstorm forces a young IT technician to stay longer than expected at an elderly woman's house, a routine service call turns into an afternoon of shared memories, unexpected conversations, and a meaningful connection between two generations.

1723990.title: Hard as Puck

1724950.title: KIND
1724950.overview: A satire on virtue-signalling and moral posturing where a man loses a promotion to a colleague.

1726230.title: Legend of Qingqiu
1726230.overview: Luo Rong'er, an illusion created by the Nine-Tailed Master, begins to question her purpose after meeting the righteous constable Mo Chen. As their bond grows, she must choose between obeying her creator and protecting the man she loves.

1727318.title: Mouthing
1727318.overview: As a boy and a girl meet at a pool party, something begins to stir underground. Their small talk is soon interrupted by the whispers of a silicon baby doll.

1727638.title: Jangan Lupa Bahagia
1727638.overview: Ulla (Alghifahri Jasin) must become the backbone for her two younger siblings, Imma (Jasmin Risach) and Ikbal (M Aqif Difullah), after their parents pass away. They are staying in an empty house owned by their father’s best friend. Ulla is determined to keep her two younger siblings in school to fulfill the dreams of their late parents. To make ends meet, Ulla works hard as an online motorcycle taxi driver. But a setback occurs when her cell phone—her primary tool for work—is severely damaged after falling and being run over by a motorcycle. At the same time, they are forced to leave the house where they’ve been staying because the homeowner’s child has decided to sell it.

1730070.title: Left ın the Dark
1730070.overview: On a dark night, Uncle Sabi, an elderly motorcyclist, offers a ride to a young woman he encounters by chance. When she disappears at the end of the journey, leaving behind an abandoned baby, the situation blurs the boundaries between compassion and responsibility. And leads to an unexpected confrontation.

1731158.title: Orange Justice
1731158.overview: Two bumbling but well-meaning NYPD cops on suspension, Murph and Taylor, are tasked with escorting a disinterested Gen Alpha teen, Lacey, to meet her estranged father in Canada.

1732182.title: Heartbreak Island
1732182.overview: Two contestants on a reality television show are busted after faking their relationship.

1733142.title: ARSIP 07: Rekaman Yang Tidak Pernah Dipublikasikan
1733142.overview: Four content creator friends—Raka, Naya, Kevin, and Bima—who love exploring horror, decide to visit a mysterious building known as the Three-Story Building, a building without doors, windows, or rooms that stands in the middle of a rice paddy. With their cameras as witnesses, they intend to prove that the haunted stories circulating are just myths.  However, from the moment they enter the building, various illogical events begin to haunt them. Mysterious voices, a dark figure visible only through the camera, and illusions of space and time trap them in an inexplicable terror. When the exit seemingly disappears and the footage begins to show a different reality, they realize that something has been watching them from the beginning.  ARSI 07: Unpublished Footage is a mockumentary and found footage horror film that creates suspense through seemingly real footage, with an ending that leaves the question: did they really escape, or have they become part of the archives forever lost?
1733142.original_title: ARSIP 07: Rekaman Yang Tidak Pernah Dipublikasikan

1734486.title: Our Share of Sand
1734486.overview: After years apart, 12 year-old Maya returns to India with her mother to reunite with her father - a sandmining business man. Immersed in a world where labour, legacy and extraction collide, she forms a fragile bond with Kiran, a young worker. After a tragic event, a police investigation turns Maya into a key witness, with her father relying on her to absolve him. Torn between loyalty and a growing unease she cannot name, Maya begins searching for the truth. As her mother quietly unravels, Maya uncovers a pattern of silence, exploitation and repeated harm forcing her to confront her father's deception and the family's complicity she must choose to break.

1735702.title: The Living Tree
1735702.overview: On their honeymoon in a treehouse, Noah and Annabelle ignore a local’s warning. They’re soon pulled into a AI-run experiment by a tech giant. As the challenges escalate, secrets emerge—and survival becomes the only thing that matters.

1738070.title: Kelsey Cook: Happy Hour
1738070.overview: In this candid and clever stand-up special, Kelsey Cook explores "hangxiety," relives a plane bathroom nightmare and breaks down dating a literal Chad.
1738070.trailerName: Happy Hour Official Trailer | Kelsey Cook

1738902.title: Kubana
1738902.overview: In Rwanda, KUBANA explores, through stories and silences, how a society chooses unity and coexistence, offering a poetic and political look at living together.

1739030.title: The Return of Omotara Johnson
1739030.overview: Haunted by her criminal past, Omotara Johnson has built a quiet life around her son. But when he's accused of murder, old enemies resurface and hidden betrayals explode. From a lover's double life to a best friend's deadly secret.
1739030.trailerName: THE RETURN OMOTARA JOHNSON OFFICIAL TRAILER 2026 PRODUCED BY BUKKY WRIGHT

1741078.title: Oscar's Date
1741078.overview: When their roommate starts dating someone from their past, three friends race to warn him before things spiral out of control.

1742678.title: PITSTOP
1742678.overview: A chance encounter at a gas station opens the doors to love and loss in this arthouse performance piece.

1742934.title: The Airport Chaplain
1742934.overview: At a bustling international airport, lost people seek missed connections, while others carry heavy personal baggage. Tobias Wallace shepherds them all. Scruffy and benevolent in his hi-vis “Chaplain”-printed vest and always on call, he’ll bend rules to help passengers and workers alike – that includes Asha, a young woman hiding in the prayer room whose murky history stirs Tobias’s own deeply buried traumas. Not everybody is a fan of his methods, however: ambitious new terminal manager Mira has liability nightmare Tobias marked for redundancy. But as crises appear everywhere – overworked baggage handlers, security breaches, families torn apart and grief-stricken relatives – maybe this infuriating chaplain could be Mira’s salvation.

1743702.title: Jason
1743702.overview: A young boy in Miami carries on with his days while the voice of his mother, recently deported, travels through the phone to try to reach him. JASON is about what happens after deportation, the felt absence, the connection that struggles to survive it and the power of a mother’s love.

1744342.title: Faccende di paese
1744342.overview: Through the perspectives of the inhabitants of a provincial town, we follow the events of a dangerous love triangle.

1744726.title: Cat on the Fly
1744726.overview: A fanciful film about a cat who was determined to fly.

1746774.title: Mordkommission Calw - Die Hesse-Verschwörung
1746774.overview: The unsuccessful and financially troubled writer Umberto Designori discovers a historical document in the Ticino village of Montagnola. Suspecting that it was authored by the famous writer Hermann Hesse, who spent the final years of his life in Montagnola, he sets off for Calw. However, the town archivist and Hesse expert, Dr. Giebenrath, reveals to him that the document is a forgery. The following night, Designori falls to his death. The supposed Hesse letter has disappeared. Detectives Lola Kraft and Jasmin Stein of the "Mordkommission Calw" begin their investigation.

1747542.title: HOW TO MAKE TURKISH EGGS
1747542.overview: A young woman cooks in her family kitchen. Through an off-screen exchange with her mother, generational tensions around womanhood, faith, and expectation quietly surface.

1747734.title: Above the Trees
1747734.overview: When something inhuman follows her home through the woods, Vera Landen calls the only voice she can reach - a late night radio host who decides her terror makes better entertainment than emergency.

1750166.title: Phantasmagoria: A Fever Dream Story
1750166.overview: Felix is living a peaceful life in his city, until him and a unorthodox detective are brought together through different worlds, to face a threat more adventurous than he could handle.

1750870.title: Julian
1750870.overview: Jabari buys a fish before his friend's birthday party.

1751062.title: Le souffle fantôme
1751062.overview: While clearing out his family’s cabin, Isaac stumbles upon an incomplete recording of a musical performance by his late father, a trumpeter. Obsessed with the missing notes, he reactivates an android programmed with his father’s memories. Together, they attempt to bring back what has been lost.

1752086.title: Peta Joy In... I'm Not A Lesbian
1752086.overview: Growing tired of her mediocre DL Trade, Peta Joy retreats into homoerotic female friendships while refusing to admit she's a lesbian.
1752086.original_title: Peta Joy In... I'm Not A Lesbian

1752150.title: Ash and Crayons
1752150.overview: Seven Ukrainian children demonstrate resilience while facing catastrophic injuries and forcible deportations during the ongoing war, their stories told through verité footage and animation by Ukrainian artists.

1753622.title: What remains
1753622.overview: Set amongst the Natisone, Valcellina and Carnia valleys in Friuli Venezia Giulia, the film recounts the preparations for and the unfolding of three different traditional rituals.

1754454.title: RAM-RAIDERS
1754454.overview: Alfonso grows up in a neighborhood marked by hardship and a lack of opportunities. The future is a distant promise, but he sees a way out in his cousin Francis: becoming a car thief like him.

1754582.title: Dragoons
1754582.overview: The documentary delves into the images that shaped the political myth of Jair Bolsonaro, from his earliest YouTube videos to the end of his term in office. Over a series of sleepless nights, a narrator drifts through Bolsonaro’s livestreams, selfies, and speeches, searching for the logic of a form of power forged through and by images. By confronting this visual regime with Brazil’s official iconography, the film explores how power is understood, repeated, and asserted through images, at a time when politics increasingly unfolds on screens.

1754838.title: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre
1754838.overview: A Hand-animated, rotoscoped adaptation of the original 1974 horror classic. Plot TBA.

1755734.title: Nihilo
1755734.overview: A woman carrying a hammer stumbles upon a mysterious door in the middle of nowhere. Now she must find a way to open it or live with the uncertainty of what might lie on the other side.

1756246.title: The Weight We Carry
1756246.overview: With a wooden chair strapped on his back, a father leaves his family in search of something he cannot name. As guilt and fear creep in, he climbs faster and faster, reaching for the summit, where rest will finally be deserved. Up there, at the top of the world, he's sitting and waiting.

1756758.title: Midnight Momo
1756758.overview: Kunga’s having a hell of a night. It’s 15 minutes to closing at the Queens momo shop where he works and things are just heating up. A homeless regular comes in for his nightly leftovers. Kunga’s girlfriend arrives with something serious to talk about. Immigration officers show up looking for the Mexican chef. Then, just as everything is boiling over, the clock strikes midnight and Kunga finds himself right back where he started — trapped in the same chaotic 15 minutes over and over.

1757078.title: The Flight
1757078.overview: On January 8, 2020, Flight PS752 was struck by two surface-to-air missiles, killing everyone on board. Director Soran Mardookhi’s feature documentary The Flight follows the lives of family members left behind as they relentlessly pursue truth, justice and accountability for their loved ones.

1757590.title: Print
1757590.overview: Molly creates art out of roadkill. Using paper and ink, Molly shares how communing with the dead can revitalize one's sense of humanity.

1759126.title: Siddha
1759126.overview: Sidha, a simple-hearted man, faces comic misunderstandings, love, and family conflict as his innocence is challenged by harsh realities.

1763350.title: Art Is Missing
1763350.overview: Set against the backdrop of present-day Athens, a city suffocating beneath overtourism, a ruthless real estate agent sets out to turn the city’s last remaining museum into a casino. Before long, the artworks stage a surreal uprising.

1763606.title: The Rooster’s Gospel
1763606.overview: The Evangelical Parable of an eleven-year-old Son who, with the blessings of his Father, is compelled at the eleventh hour, during his school play, to exchange the role of the Rooster for that of Christ before a newly affluent and insatiable audience.

1763798.title: Lāhainā: Voices of Change
1763798.overview: On August 8, 2024, the town of Lahaina was devastated by a massive wildfire, leaving most of the historic town in ruins. It became one of the deadliest wildfires in U.S. history, displacing thousands of residents and claiming many lives. A year later, this small, close-knit community continues to struggle with rebuilding. The disaster has revealed deeper issues, including the impacts of climate change, land management challenges, dependence on tourism, and the housing crisis. Once the capital of the Hawaiian monarchy, Lahaina holds deep ancestral ties, with families tracing their roots back multiple generations. Now, as the town starts the long process of healing.

1766358.title: 程序乱码（DLP造梦实验室版）
1766358.original_title: 程序乱码（DLP造梦实验室版）

1769302.title: The Lamp
1769302.overview: 1924, provincial Germany. Helmut is an office clerk, tired of how difficult it is to be a human. When he sees a lamp in a shop window, he fantasizes about trading places with it, setting him on a path towards freedom from his troubles.

1769878.title: The Way Out
1769878.overview: The Way Out drops you right into the action across the globe, from heavy Alaskan spine lines to local backyard laps in Whistler. It represents a path toward total freedom, whether tracking Hoji, Chris Rubens, and Mark Abma across the iconic Swiss Alps, or capturing breakout skier Lucy Leishman storming through Japan’s deep powder with three legendary freeskiers. The verdict is simple: the soul of skiing isn’t dead. It’s alive and well, wherever the snow is falling.

1770326.title: A Summer of Nothing
1770326.overview: Filmmaker Alina Manolache arrives on an island in Greece with grand plans to film a documentary on Venus de Milo's repatriation, but the project does not materialise. Finding it impossible to accept the new situation, Alina decides to dissect her obsession for work and achievement, through an experiment of doing the exact opposite: nothing. But is there ever nothing? As she meets Mady, a local woman with a very busy family life, the study of nothing turns into a labyrinthine personal journey.

1773014.title: 4 Out
1773014.original_title: 4アウト ─もう一度、プレイボール─

1773270.title: Hearts All Aglow
1773270.overview: Mari is a fiercely intelligent music historian who manages to get an invite to the annual Christmas gala for the local music museum and has one goal: secure an interview with Tasha the legendary Grammy award-winning singer, record producer, and museum’s founder. Mari has to summon the courage to ask the mogul who rarely does interviews these days for this favor, which proves more difficult than anticipated. Also crashing the gala is Julian, a polished and perpetually busy New York attorney on a mission of his own: his late mother received the autograph of Nat King Cole on a piece of sheet music when she was a young girl and he regrettably donated this treasured piece of family history to the DuPree Museum while emotionally numb in the aftermath of his mother’s death. Now his sister tells him she wants to give the framed sheet music to her daughter/his niece, who inherited her grandmother’s musical talent, for Christmas, and Julian is determined to bring it back home.
